newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo Nobel 1996 net profit NLG 1.32 bln.
newsitem.headline: Akzo Nobel 1996 net profit NLG 1.32 bln.

text.p: Dutch chemical group Akzo Nobel NV said on Thursday its 1996 net profit rose to 1.318 billion guilders ($694.2 million) from 1.314 billion in 1995.

Fourth quarter net profit rose to 291 million guilders from 201 million in the same period of 1995. Akzo Nobel said it would pay a 1996 dividend of 7.50 guilders per share, up from 7.00 guilders in 1995.
The group said it expected higher net income in the current year.
"Akzo Nobel foresees continued moderate and fairly stable growth in our most important markets. In our other markets we expect economic conditions to remain substantially the same.
"Based on this scenario, we expect a higher net income," it said in a statement.
It said sales would be roughly the same as in 1996, despite some important deconsolidations in 1997 which would include Salt America.
Sales in 1996 totalled 22.44 billion guilders. ($ = 1.898 Dutch Guilders)
